tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground. Code pairing: bg-paper dark:bg-night.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels set on the ground: cartouche panel, empty state, inputs, inactive pills. Code: bg-white dark:bg-night-2 (cards also use bg-paper dark:bg-night-2).

tokens.name: surface-recessed
tokens.usage: Recessed cells: chips, table cells, ghost-button hover, legends. Code: bg-paper-2 dark:bg-night-3.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Every 1px hairline: card borders, dividers, legend rows. Code: border-line dark:border-night-line (the most used pair in the app).

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Hover border on cards, borders between major sections.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings and primary lettering. 17.2:1 on surface (day), 16.8:1 (night). Code: text-ink dark:text-snow.

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Running copy and descriptions. 10.1:1 on paper, 12.2:1 on night.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, coordinates, legend terms, sheet margin. 6.1:1 on paper, 7.5:1 on night.

tokens.name: text-accent
tokens.usage: Red lettering: links, active tab, live labels. 4.58:1 on paper (AA), only 4.18:1 on paper-2: use brand-strong there. brand-soft is 7.6:1 on night.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Lettering on a brand or brand-strong fill (4.75:1 and 6.1:1). Also on vert (5.1:1) and hydro (5.1:1).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Global :focus-visible outline: 2px solid, 2px offset, in both themes.

tokens.name: neat
tokens.usage: Ink of the neatline frame (CSS var --neat in globals.css).

tokens.name: strip
tokens.usage: Ink of the graduated scale strip (CSS var --strip).

tokens.name: tick
tokens.usage: Corner-tick ink (CSS var --tick; components set dark:[--tick:var(--color-snow-3)]).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Day map paper: the base ground of every day sheet.

tokens.name: paper-2
tokens.usage: Recessed survey ground: chips, tabular cells, scrollbar track.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Day 1px hairline (neatlines, dividers). Decorative only: 1.3:1 on paper, never a control border alone.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Day high-contrast divider, card hover border, scrollbar thumb.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Printed black: headings, primary text, scale-bar segments, outline buttons.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Body ink on day paper.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Muted ink: captions, coordinates, legend terms (6.1:1 on paper).

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Lettering on red, green and blue fills; day panels (bg-white) and inputs.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Route red, the club colour, calibrated for UI: primary buttons, active tabs, live dots, focus ring, caret, selection. White on it 4.75:1; on paper 4.58:1. Never a broad wash.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed of brand, red text on brand-tint (5.4:1), prose links.

tokens.name: brand-vif
tokens.usage: Map road red and the Heart Line mark. Large fields and strokes only: 4.1:1 on paper is below AA for small text.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Crimson wash behind brand/danger badges and admin-danger buttons. Text on it: brand-strong.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Red lettering on night sheets (7.6:1 on night). Fails on paper (2.4:1): night only.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Night sheet ground.

tokens.name: night-2
tokens.usage: Raised night panel, cards, inactive pills on night.

tokens.name: night-3
tokens.usage: Recessed night cells, inputs on night, ghost hover.

tokens.name: night-line
tokens.usage: Night 1px hairline.

tokens.name: night-line-strong
tokens.usage: Night high-contrast divider, legend borders in the nuit cartouche.

tokens.name: snow
tokens.usage: Night primary lettering (16.8:1 on night).

tokens.name: snow-2
tokens.usage: Night body copy, scale-strip ink on night.

tokens.name: snow-3
tokens.usage: Night muted lettering, neatline and tick ink on night (7.5:1 on night).

tokens.name: bistre
tokens.usage: Relief bistre: contours, elevation, gravel. As text 3.9:1 on paper (large only); use bistre-ink for small text.

tokens.name: bistre-soft
tokens.usage: Light bistre for elevation fills and profiles.

tokens.name: bistre-ink
tokens.usage: Bistre lettering on paper (6.1:1).

tokens.name: hydro
tokens.usage: Hydro blue: rivers, wind vectors, GPX tracks, weather. 5.0:1 on paper.

tokens.name: hydro-soft
tokens.usage: Light hydro for water fills and charts.

tokens.name: hydro-tint
tokens.usage: Hydro wash behind weather/info callouts.

tokens.name: bois
tokens.usage: Bois de Buis woodland tint: forest fills, Carré Vert chip ground (vert text on it 4.1:1: use vert-strong for small text).

tokens.name: vert
tokens.usage: Woodland green: Carré Vert, attendance, validated rides, vert cartouche. White on it 5.1:1.

tokens.name: vert-strong
tokens.usage: Success badge text on vert-tint (6.2:1), vert cartouche on night.

tokens.name: vert-vif
tokens.usage: Success lettering on night (6.0:1).

tokens.name: vert-tint
tokens.usage: Success badge ground.

tokens.name: ambre
tokens.usage: Amber: warnings, secondary roads, detours. Never text on paper (2.3:1); fine as text on night (8.0:1).

tokens.name: ambre-ink
tokens.usage: Warning lettering on paper (5.5:1).

tokens.name: jaune
tokens.usage: Map yellow, sparing highlight on map layers.

tokens.name: map-paper
tokens.usage: Territory map ground.

tokens.name: map-woods
tokens.usage: Woods mask layer (carte-woods).

tokens.name: map-contour
tokens.usage: 5 m contour lines (carte-relief).

tokens.name: map-contour-index
tokens.usage: Index contour lines (carte-relief-index).

tokens.name: map-water
tokens.usage: Rivers: the Dyle and tributaries (carte-water).

tokens.name: map-lake
tokens.usage: Lakes and ponds (carte-lakes).

tokens.name: map-road-major
tokens.usage: Major roads.

tokens.name: map-road-primary
tokens.usage: Primary roads.

tokens.name: map-road-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary roads (amber).

tokens.name: map-road-tertiary
tokens.usage: Tertiary roads and lanes.

tokens.name: map-rail
tokens.usage: Railway.

tokens.name: map-grid
tokens.usage: Kilometric grid printed over the sheet (2 km cells).

tokens.name: map-label
tokens.usage: Place names on the map.

tokens.name: map-halo
tokens.usage: Paper glow behind map labels (map-label utility).

tokens.name: map-wind
tokens.usage: Wind field particles and vectors.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Cartouche title (SheetHeader h1): stretch-wide, uppercase, clamp(2.1rem, 4.8vw, 4.25rem); size lg clamp(2.4rem, 6vw, 5.25rem). One per page.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Section headline: stretch-semiwide, uppercase, clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem). No eyebrow above it.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: Boucle de la Dyle par Mont-Saint-Guibert
styles.usage: Route names, drawer and dialog titles, card titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Départ Place de la Féchère à 8 h 30, regroupement au sommet de chaque côte.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Badges, legend terms, table headers, coordinates: stretch-narrow, uppercase. Legend terms and sheet margin use 11px and 0.12em.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button lettering: stretch-narrow, uppercase. sm 0.75rem, lg 0.875rem.

styles.name: telemetry
styles.usage: Every cycling metric: tabular-nums, stretch-semiwide in legends, French number format with non-breaking space before the unit.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The club wordmark: stretch-wide, uppercase; lg size 1.875rem.

styles.name: prose-h2
styles.sample: La montée du Mur de Huy
styles.usage: Article h2: stretch-semiwide, clamp(1.45rem, 2.8vw, 1.9rem), hairline rule above.

styles.name: prose-body
styles.sample: Nous avons quitté Blanmont sous une bruine fine, le vent dans le dos jusqu'à Chastre.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in small chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Button inner gap, badge gap, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Legend row padding, small button padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile gutter, button padding, card padding minimum.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Tablet gutter, card and cartouche padding (mobile).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop gutter, empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Cartouche panel padding (sm+).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section spacing, empty-state padding (sm+).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Large section breaks.

radius.note: Printed sheet corners stay crisp. Pills only for status chips.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Scrollbar thumb, hairline details.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Empty-state icon box, small cells, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Panels.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Largest sheet containers.

tokens.name: radius-3xl
tokens.usage: Maximum: dialogs and drawers.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status chips, badges and pills only. Never buttons.

shadow.note: Flat at rest. Paper lifts only when raised (menus, dialogs, drawers, the cartouche over the map band).

tokens.name: shadow-2xs
tokens.usage: Small inputs.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Inputs.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Card hover lift.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Cartouche panel over the map band.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dropdowns, popovers, filter trays.

tokens.name: shadow-xl
tokens.usage: Drawers.

tokens.name: shadow-2xl
tokens.usage: Modal dialogs.

fontStretch.note: Archivo's width axis carries the hierarchy (Tailwind utilities font-wide, font-semiwide, font-narrow, font-condensed).

tokens.name: stretch-wide
tokens.usage: Display, cartouche titles, wordmark.

tokens.name: stretch-semiwide
tokens.usage: Headlines, legend values, map labels, prose headings.

tokens.name: stretch-narrow
tokens.usage: Labels, badges, buttons, table headers.

tokens.name: stretch-condensed
tokens.usage: Dense map annotations.

easing.note: Durations: 150ms for state changes, 550ms stamp-in, 2.4s sheet develop. All animation stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: ease-plot
tokens.usage: Plotting: sheet develop, route draw, compass turn, pulse ring.

tokens.name: ease-stamp
tokens.usage: Stamp-in of badges and markers, wordmark hover.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Tablet gutter, larger cartouche band.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Wordmark subline appears.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Cartouche splits into title and legend columns; 32px gutter.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Container max width.
